name: mssql-readonly-mcp
description: An MCP server that lets an AI assistant read one on-premises SQL Server database.

connection_string.title: SQL Server connection string
connection_string.description: Becomes MSSQL_CONNECTION_STRING. Use a login that passes check-login (see the README, "Create the read-only login"). The server adds ApplicationIntent=ReadOnly and Application Name=mssql-readonly-mcp.

audit_log.title: Audit file path
audit_log.description: Becomes MSSQL_MCP_AUDIT_LOG. Path of the audit file, created with its folder if missing. Each server process needs its own audit file.
